scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n bridge,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:bridge" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: cargo build --release --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml && npm run build -w client
scripts.app:install: npm run app:build && rm -rf ~/Applications/ClawdDesk.app && mkdir -p ~/Applications && cp -R desktop/target/release/bundle/macos/ClawdDesk.app ~/Applications/ && open ~/Applications/ClawdDesk.app
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run typecheck -w client && npm test -w client
